text_block_list.text:
It was a fierce bout with Мэйсё Дото
running
desperately. But in the end, she
finished
victorious.

Unbelievable! To think I would be
outshone when
the stage was
undoubtedly mine!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You cunning assassin! You robber of
crowns!
Prithee, what be thy name?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So that is what you go by? King
Ah-um-ah!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото is clearly flustered by T.M.
Opera
O's theatrics.

The littlest praise frazzles her brain. I
might need
to watch my words...

Like last time, Мэйсё Дото is taken
away by an
ambulance. Thankfully,
there's no serious ailment
to speak of.
These kinds of high-octane races
really
do a number on her body.
